Name: Speremint's Portraits
Author: speremint
Description:
Hello!

[b]3/21/2024!
[/b]Mod isn't abandoned, I'd really like to finish it, but with 1.6 I will need to work on the added winter outfits! I'm going to try to just finish the base villagers first, and then once all of those done, I will work on their seasonal outfits.

It's been a hot minute but fellas, we've done it. I have finally finished up the 1.5 compatible version of my portrait mod! I am slowly working on getting the rest of the villagers done, but for now, please enjoy all of the love interests!

I admit I'm a little iffy on some of the portraits (I might be redoing Maru), but I'm pretty happy with how these have come out.

Future Plans:
[list]
[*]Finish rest of villagers
[*]Make SVE Compatible
[*]Seasonal Outfits (sobs, one day)
[*]MAKE 1.6 COMPATIBLE (portraits will work, but in winter they will swap to vanilla winter outfits)
[/list]
[b]Additional Compatibilities:
>[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17214]Yandere Elliott[/url]﻿[/b]
I hope y'all enjoy and thanks for everyone who patiently waited for me to get an update out.

-
